question: How do devoted knowers mutually delight in the Lord?
premises: All knowers are one Lord through pervasion
inference: Mutual enlightenment among devoted knowers reveals the one Lord pervading all.
uncertainties: Long compounds are glossed as wholes
The numeral token is retained as given
plain_english: With minds fixed on me and lives gone to me, they enlighten and tell of me always, delighting one another through mutual knowing; all knowers are one Lord, attained easily by pervasion.
